notes: Non-negative [0,1) input (see kernelforge::reference::reduce_sum's double-accumulation rationale). Same sizes/seed for all five variants so they are directly comparable -- see src/kernels/reduction/README.md for what each rung changes. v0_naive_global_atomic was added after v1-v4's numbers were already collected (see that README's 'Ladder history' note) and was backfilled in a separate pass (hard constraint 9) for the five of six configured sizes at which it passes correctness -- it fails the correctness gate at n=67108864 from fp32 accumulator saturation (see benchmarks/methodology.md sec 9.1), so that one size is deliberately absent from its rows in benchmarks/raw/reduction.jsonl. scripts/run_bench_reduction.sh reproduces exactly this committed shape from a fresh clone (v1-v4 at all six configured sizes, v0 at five of them) via two separate --only-variant/--only-sweep-value-filtered bench_driver.py calls -- it deliberately does NOT run one plain sweep over this config's full (variants x sweep_values) grid, which would always fail loudly on v0's excluded point.
